t: The rectangle represents a set of calculations that that are common across all the given equations. Identify the calculations involved and solve the fourth equation on the same basis.
e: Option (a): (a + 2b + 2) When a = 3; b = 6, then we get: (a + 2b + 2) = 3 + 2*6 + 2 = 3 + 12 + 2 = 17 When a = 9; b = 2, then we get: (a + 2b + 2) = 9 + 2*2 + 2 = 9 + 4 + 2 = 15 When a = 7; b = 11, then we get: (a + 2b + 2) = 7 + 2*11 + 2 = 7 + 22 + 2 = 31 Here, for all three values, the equation is not satisfied. Option (b): (3a + 2b) When a = 3; b = 6, then we get: (3a + 2b) = 3*3 + 2*6 = 9 + 12 = 21 When a = 9; b = 2, then we get: (3a + 2b) = 3*9 + 2*2 = 27 + 4 = 31 When a = 7; b = 11, then we get: (3a + 2b) = 3*7 + 2*11 = 21 + 22 = 43 Here, for all three values, the equation is not satisfied. Option (c): (2ab + b + 1) When a = 3; b = 6, then we get: (2ab + b + 1) = 2*3*6 + 6 + 1 = 36 + 6 + 1 = 43 When a = 9; b = 2, then we get: (2ab + b + 1) = 2*9*2 + 2 + 1 = 36 + 2 + 1 = 39 When a = 7; b = 11, then we get: (2ab + b + 1) = 2*7*11 + 11 + 1 = 154 + 11 + 1 = 166 Here, for all three values, the equation is satisfied. Option (d): (ab + 3a) When a = 3, b = 6, then we get: (ab + 3a) = 3*6 + 3*3 = 18 + 9 = 27 When a = 9, b = 2, then we get: (ab + 3a) = 9*2 + 3*9 = 18 + 27 = 45 When a = 7, b = 11, then we get: (ab + 3a) = 7*11 + 3*7 = 77 + 21 = 98 Here, for all three values, the equation is not satisfied.

t: In a group of 72 workers, each worker participates in one more of three activities, i.e. Quiz, Mono-acting and Mimicry. 11 workers participate in Quiz only, 15 participate in Mono Acting only and 14 participate in Mimicry only. If 5 workers participate in all three activities, then how many workers participate in any two activities?
e: using the diagram method :- ∴ {15 + 11 + 14} + 5 + [a + b + c] = 72 ∴ 45 + [a + b + c] = 72 a + b + c = 27 ∴ Num of workers participated in any two activity = 27 आरेख विधि का उपयोग करके :- ∴ {15 + 11 + 14} + 5 + [a + b + c] = 72 ∴ 45 + [a + b + c] = 72 a + b + c = 27 ∴ किसी भी दो गतिविधि में भाग लेने वाले श्रमिकों की संख्या = 27
